Aisha (CSM): Heads up — Lighthouse onboarding call tomorrow 11am PT. They asked for a clear SLO/SLA rundown (uptime 99.9, p95 latency 300ms) and want to understand how latency credits are calculated if we miss targets. Can SRE/eng prep a short explainer and evidence bundle?
Ben (AE): I’ll be on the call too. Customer is concerned about bursty inference jobs during ETL windows — wants example scenarios where credits would apply.
Carlos (SRE): Ack. I can grab synthetic test results and last 30d latency histograms. Will also pull exemplar traces for the ETL peak we saw last month.
Marta (Engineer): I can prepare a 1-slide summary on how prefix caching and batching affect p95 vs. p99, plus recommended config to avoid credit triggers.
Carlos (SRE): For the evidence bundle I’ll include: 1) synthetic probe results (region/us-west-2), 2) KV cache hit ratio, 3) latency percentiles by model and route, 4) node-level GPU metrics. Example snippet: ```
# probe summary
date, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms
2026-03-01, 45, 210, 480
2026-03-15, 50, 320, 810
```
Aisha (CSM): Perfect. Can you also include the exact calculation we use for credits (minutes of violation x committed throughput fraction)? They want to see the math during renewal talks.
Marta (Engineer): Quick note — for dedicated customers the credit calc differs slightly when autoscaling kicks in. I’ll add a short note and a link to the runbook.
Carlos (SRE): @oncall-bot can you attach the recent incident report for the 2026-02-14 ETL spike? Need timestamps and remediation timeline.
oncall-bot: Attached: incident-20260214-etl-spike.pdf (3 pages) — contains timeline, impact window (00:42–01:13 UTC), and remediation notes.
Ben (AE): Great — I’ll take ownership of presenting the credit example on the call. Aisha, can you paste the customer’s exact wording about what they consider an "outage" vs "degraded" experience so we’re aligned?
Aisha (CSM): Pasting: "If API calls fail (5xx) for more than 5 continuous minutes = outage; if p95 latency > 1s for a route for > 30m in a day = degraded and eligible for credits."
Carlos (SRE): That wording maps cleanly to our telemetry. I’ll produce a short table mapping our telemetry signals -> SLA triggers (eg. 5xx rate, p95 window, prefix cache miss windows).
Marta (Engineer): I’ll add a recommended playbook: 1) short-term config tweaks (reduce max batch size for heavy routes), 2) medium-term (pin quantized model variant), 3) long-term (workload-aware autoscale policy).
Aisha (CSM): Timeline plan: Carlos/Marta — please drop artifacts in the shared folder by EOD today so I can circulate before the call. Ben — we’ll run through the credit calc in rehearsals at 10:30am.
Ben (AE): Roger.
Carlos (SRE): Will do. Dropping probe CSV + traces to: drive.redwood.com/lighthouse/onboard/sla-evidence/
Aisha (CSM): Thanks team :heart: — see you on the call.
